name: Discrete Volume Rendering Integral (VRI)
definition: Fragment shader computes VRI by iterating along segment between entry $s_{in}$ and exit $s_{out}$ in steps of $\Delta s$.
summary: The Discrete Volume Rendering Integral computes pixel color via fixed-step front-to-back compositing, distinguished by its implementation as a Pass 2 fragment shader using pre-computed coordinates and strict fixed-step spacing.
